_about: The one list of what tests/ux/measure.mjs does not count as an offence. Every entry says what it matches (`selector`), how (`match`: self = the element itself, within = the element or anything inside one), and why (`reason`, at least 20 characters). loadExemptions refuses an entry without a reason, and tests/ux/measure-exemptions.test.mjs fails an entry whose selector names nothing in src/ (a stale exemption) unless it is a library class. Add to this list only with a ruling or a stated reason; the measure has no list of its own.

overflow.reason: a declared sideways strip (theme strip, facet strip, headline track, matrix scroller, row table) scrolls inside its own box by design; the page does not.
visually hidden text is positioned off the layout box on purpose and is read by assistive technology only.
a virtualised list row is absolutely positioned by the virtualizer with a transform; its box is measured by the row itself, and the list container clips it.
the map is Leaflet's own canvas of tiles and panes, which are larger than the viewport by design and clipped by the container; the library draws them, the page does not.

target.reason: a link inside running prose of a brief is inline text, not a stand-alone target (WCAG 2.5.8 inline exception); stand-alone links to the same places are 44 px.
a scrollable region made keyboard-focusable so it can be scrolled with the keys (WCAG 2.1.1); it is a container, not a control to hit.
a scrollable region made keyboard-focusable so it can be scrolled with the keys (WCAG 2.1.1); it is a container, not a control to hit.

collapsed.reason: the visually hidden file input of an upload button is kept focusable for the keyboard and for assistive technology; the visible button beside it is the 44 px target.
